name: daydream - Bairimeng
source:
This is a galgame that integrates love, campus, and suspense elements. Players can experience love stories with different female protagonists from the perspective of the protagonist.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903370/daydream/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一款集爱情、校园、悬疑元素为一体的galgame。玩家可以从主角的角度体验与不同女主角的爱情故事。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903370/daydream/]Steam[/url]]
